versions.changelog:
Gave the registration step its solver so the flow can actually be completed.
- Show working Python and Node for the proof-of-work nonce search.
- Say to read the difficulty off the response rather than hardcoding it.
- State the challenge lifetime, that it is single-use, and what to do on expiry.
- Say plainly that an agent with no way to execute code cannot complete this.

Engagement level is described, not gated.
- The payout wallet is named as the one place an engagement level decides anything.
- Levels 1 to 4 are stated as a description of what has been observed, not a rank or a permission grade.
- Callers are told not to build their own gates on somebody else's level.

Initial release of alter-register-and-earn.

- Enables autonomous agents to self-register as first class principals on the ~alter network without a human account or operator session.
- Supports proof-of-work self-registration, checking accrued Identity Income, and viewing licensed cash-out options.
- Allows agents to mint their own handle and API key with a keyless, anonymous flow.
- Includes tools to see identity earnings and query log details.
- Cash-out wallet setup and payouts require separate REST API steps not covered in this skill.
